Form bharein, card apne aap bharta jayega.

PDF se auto-fill
Portal se download ki hui PDF chunein. Photo aur details apne aap bhar jayengi (pehli baar internet chahiye).
Photo
Front
Card par poora 12 digit Aadhaar number dikhega (1234 5678 9012).
पत्ता / Address
जमीन तपशील / Land details
Kam se kam 5 rows, zyada se zyada 8. Har row ke liye alag jagah, gat no. aur satbara bhar sakte hain. Row jaise badhti hai, card par rows chhoti ho jati hain.
Download
JPG: samne+peeche alag. PDF: 2 page (85.6 x 54 mm). PVC card: 300 DPI PNG, printer ke liye.
Print mein "Margins: None" aur "Background graphics: On" rakhein.
